title: Unified incident breadcrumbs for analytics: correlate metrics, logs, and KV-cache traces
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: When analytics SLOs degrade (ingest lag, spikes in token cost, per-tenant errors) engineers spend too long stitching evidence from metrics, logs, and trace snapshots across services. Existing traces are high-fidelity but bulky; logs are noisy and lack fast cross-indexing; metrics point to symptoms but not breadcrumb context. Goal: produce a low-cost, queryable breadcrumb stream that binds together a minimal timeline of events (metrics anomaly markers, important log events, KV-cache eviction/restore markers, and request-level trace anchors) to enable 5–15 minute forensic turnaround for analytics incidents.
scope: Emit lightweight breadcrumb events from console-backend ingestion, analytics-ingest workers, router, and KV-cache service. Ingest into a dedicated index with short TTL and precomputed join keys. Provide query API + Grafana dashboard slices and a Console runbook view that surfaces the breadcrumb timeline for a tenant or request id.
design_summary: Breadcrumb schema = {ts, tenant_id, breadcrumb_type, fingerprint, severity, related_ids, short_message, service, host, sample_rate_tag}. Fingerprint is a normalized 8-char hash representing equivalent events (e.g., 'prefix_cache_miss' across services). Breadcrumbs will be sampled adaptively: always keep high-severity or SLO-related events; low-severity events sampled probabilistically with tenant-prioritized weighting. Trace anchors will reference trace_id/span_id where available; we will not re-ingest full traces. Storage: a compact columnar table in ClickHouse (or equivalent) with TTL of 30 days by default and hot index for last 7 days. Query API exposes tenant/time window/trace_id/fingerprint filters with pre-joined metrics annotations.
acceptance_criteria: Breadcrumb events emitted from at least 3 producers (console-backend, analytics-ingest, kv-cache) in canary cluster
Indexed query for breadcrumbs returns results for a sample incident within 5s for 95th percentile of queries
Grafana dashboard panel visualizes breadcrumb timeline and links to trace/log artifacts
Runbook updated and on-call can reproduce investigation steps within 15 minutes for a seeded test incident
Additional storage cost impact estimated and <10% for analytics observability budget
implementation_steps: Design final breadcrumb schema and mapping (contrib: @Marco Rios, @Lina Gomez)
Add breadcrumb emitters: console request lifecycle hooks, ingest worker eviction hook, router overload detector
Implement adaptive sampler library and tenant-prioritized sampling policy
Add ingestion pipeline job to normalize and write breadcrumbs into ClickHouse index
Expose read API endpoint with tenant/time/trace filters + pagination
Create Grafana panel and Console 'Incident Breadcrumbs' view prototype
Smoke test with synthetic incident, iterate on schema and retention
Rollout canary -> prod with feature flag and monitoring dashboards
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: High cardinality from free-text messages. Mitigation: enforce short_message truncation and fingerprinting to normalize variants.
Risk: Storage growth. Mitigation: 30-day TTL + aggressive 7-day hot index + sampling of low-value events.
Risk: PII leakage in breadcrumbs. Mitigation: add sanitizer layer to strip tenant-visible PII; require security review for any schema change.
Risk: Query latency under load. Mitigation: pre-aggregate recent window and add rate limits on ad-hoc queries.
qa_plan: Unit tests for emitter library and sampler logic
Integration test: synthetic incident flow that emits breadcrumbs and verifies query output
Load test: simulate 10k TPS of low-severity events to validate ingestion scaling and TTL eviction
Security review and e2e scan for PII or secret leakage
notes: Related doc: ENG-45123 (trace compactification) provides the trace-anchor pattern we reuse
We will coordinate with Console FE team for https linking to trace UI
